note: Increment next_cc_id each time a new CC-XXXX card is generated. card_files is the explicit manifest the fetch-based loader (loadRegistryViaFetch, added 2026-08-21) uses to know which cards exist -- fetch() cannot list a folder's contents the way the folder-picker can, so this list must be kept in sync manually: add the new filename here whenever a card is saved. Missing an entry means that card silently never loads for a visitor who hasn't clicked Load. CC-0014 was missed at the time it was built (2026-08-25) and only caught while building CC-0015 -- worth double-checking this list against the actual concept_cards folder periodically, not just trusting it stays current.
